editorial.blurb: A beloved Korean spot in Chicago that delivers craveable, affordable comfort food with stellar execution—from crispy fried chicken to inventive fusion dishes that keep locals coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Get there early or during off-peak hours if you're in a larger group; it's tiny with counter ordering, so solo diners and pairs have the easiest time finding seats, but the food quality makes any wait worthwhile.
